_meta.source: fal.ai queue OpenAPI schemas, MiniMax platform docs, Alibaba Model Studio docs, Volcengine Ark docs
_meta.binding_rule: Each value is the tighter of fal and the vendor, so a prompt that passes is accepted by both. null means genuinely unpublished: the checker skips that rule rather than inventing a bound.
_meta.case_warning: Resolution case is load-bearing on MiniMax, which wants 768P and 2K. Wan accepts either case depending on the surface (lowercase on fal, uppercase on Alibaba's own API); Seedance is lowercase on both.

universal.max_prompt_chars_note: Not a vendor limit and not the floor of the three families here, which is Wan at 5000. It is the practical floor across the wider field: many models outside this table cap a prompt at 1500 or 2000 characters, and a ten-second clip does not reward more. Target 400 to 900.

forbidden_reasons.@(?:Image|Video|Audio|图片|图|视频|音频)\\s*\\d: a family-specific mention syntax; the universal prompt describes assets in words
forbidden_reasons.\\b(?:Image|Video|Audio) [1-9][0-9]?\\b: MiniMax and Wan spaced mention syntax

hailuo.name_note: There is no product called Hailuo 03. The lineage is Hailuo 02, then Hailuo 2.3, then H3 from 2026-07-31. H3 Max is fal's post-trained variant.
hailuo.max_prompt_chars_note: Model-enforced. fal's schema accepts 50000, which the model then truncates. Target 350 to 500 English words in reference mode.
hailuo.duration_note: MiniMax's own API allows 4 seconds; fal's floor is 5.
hailuo.aspect_ratio_note: image-to-video exposes no aspect_ratio field; the output follows the input image. reference-to-video is the only mode that pins the product and forces 9:16.

forbidden_reasons.@(?:Image|Video|Audio|图片|图|视频|音频)\\s*\\d: Seedance @-mention syntax; H3 uses a spaced 'Image 1'
forbidden_reasons.\\[(?:Truck|Pan|Push|Pull|Pedestal|Tilt|: camera brackets belong to Hailuo 2.3, Hailuo 02 and Video-01 Director, never to H3, which wants camera motion written as prose

wan.max_prompt_chars_note: fal-enforced. The vendor allows 20000. Write to 5000 so the prompt is portable. Practical band: 150 to 600 characters for one shot, 600 to 1200 for a storyboarded piece.
wan.aspect_ratio_note: No 21:9. Default adaptive follows the source asset, so set 9:16 explicitly.
wan.negative_prompt_note: Wan 2.5, 2.6 and 2.7 have negative_prompt at up to 500 characters. Wan 3.0 removed it; exclusions go inline as positive constraints.
wan.reference_mention_format: 图{n} | 视频{n} | 音频{n}  (English: Image {n} | Video {n})
wan.multi_shot_note: Prose only. Wan 3.0 exposes no multi_shots or shot_type flag. Write 生成单镜头 to force one take.

forbidden_reasons.@(?:Image|Video|Audio|图片|图|视频|音频)\\s*\\d: the @-mention belongs to Wan 2.6 and to Seedance; 3.0 uses 图1 or a spaced 'Image 1'

wan.resolutions_note: fal's schema spells them lowercase; Alibaba's own API reference spells them uppercase. Both spellings are listed so a prompt written for either surface passes; write the one your endpoint documents.

seedance.display_name: ByteDance Seedance 2.5, with 2.0 as the cheaper tier
seedance.max_prompt_chars_note: Unpublished by both fal and Volcengine, so the checker skips the rule. The docs recommend staying under 500 Chinese characters or 1000 English words; beyond that the model drops elements.
seedance.negative_prompt_note: No parameter. Only subtitles and audio are formally negatable in the prompt: 保持无字幕, 不要生成Logo, 无bgm.
seedance.timestamps_note: Seedance 2.0 ignores timestamps and responds only to 镜头1 / 镜头2 shot numbers. Seedance 2.5 responds to integer-second timestamps.

forbidden_reasons.\\b(?:Image|Video|Audio) [1-9][0-9]?\\b: the spaced form is MiniMax and Wan; Seedance wants @图片1 or @Image1 with no space
forbidden_reasons.--(?:rs|rt|dur|cf|wm|seed|ratio|resoluti: legacy Seedance 1.x text-command flags; 2.x ignores them and they can leak into the render
